text: The collector stamps received_at, returns 202 only after the batch is durably stored, and rejects malformed events (missing event_id or device_id, or over 32 KB) one at a time while accepting the rest. Rejected events are never retried.

Client retry behaviour: on a timeout, 429 or 5xx, the same batch is resent with the same event_ids and exponential backoff from 1 s to 5 minutes. The mobile on-device buffer holds events for up to 7 days.
Deduplication on event_id alone, first copy received wins, effective for duplicates arriving up to 7 days after the first copy.
Events are assigned to the UTC day of server received_at (not the client timestamp) for partitioning and replay.
A copy of every accepted event, duplicates included, is kept exactly as received for 90 days.

Replay of one closed day (from 02:00 UTC the next day) that does not slow live ingestion or change live dedup state, and that makes the rebuilt day visible atomically so dashboards never see a partial day.
Live events are queryable in events_clean within 5 minutes.
Bot-traffic handling (drop or keep with a flag) is marked as an open question, not decided.
